tasks.label: 🧹 Clean cache & backup files
tasks.command: git rm -r --cached __pycache__ .pytest_cache *.db *.duckdb *.log *.save* || true && rm -rf __pycache__ .pytest_cache *.db *.duckdb *.log *.save* && git add . && git commit -m 'chore: clean cache and backup files' || echo 'No cache files to clean'

tasks.label: 🧱 Reorganize repository structure
tasks.command: mkdir -p docs infra tests .github/workflows && mv docker-compose.yml infra/ 2>/dev/null || true && git add . && git commit -m 'chore(structure): reorganize repo into infra/docs/tests folders' || echo 'Structure already clean'

tasks.label: 🧩 Set up CI & test scaffold
tasks.command:
mkdir -p .github/workflows tests && echo 'def test_placeholder(): assert True' > tests/test_api.py && echo 'name: CI
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: 3.12
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r backend/requirements.txt pytest ruff black isort
      - name: Lint and test
        run: |
          ruff check .
          pytest -v' > .github/workflows/ci.yml && git add . && git commit -m 'ci: add workflow and test scaffold' || echo 'CI already configured'

tasks.label: 🚀 Push & Tag v0.2-prep
tasks.command: git push origin main || git push origin master && git tag -a v0.2-prep -m 'Repository cleanup and structure reorganization' && git push origin v0.2-prep || echo 'Tag already exists'

tasks.label: 🔍 Verify GitHub Actions pipeline status
tasks.command: curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/jfbinTECHA/brain-swarm/actions/runs?per_page=1 | grep -E 'status|conclusion' || echo 'Unable to fetch workflow status'
